findings.claim: The profile-off control does not explicitly clear OD_BUILD_PROFILE, so an inherited knowdesign environment can make the control run with the profile still enabled.
findings.evidence: upstreamEnv(proxyPort, null) uses `...(profile ? { OD_BUILD_PROFILE: profile } : {})`, omitting the variable rather than overriding it. The control passes that environment to toolsDev and expects upstream traffic. The same omission appears in e2e/ui/knowdesign-fresh-install.test.ts's startFreshRuntime environment, whose stock control expects Cloud onboarding. In contrast, knowdesignLaunchEnv in e2e/specs/mac.spec.ts explicitly deletes the inherited variable for its control.
findings.suggested_fix: Set OD_BUILD_PROFILE to an empty string for profile-off runtime launches, including both tools-dev and UI controls, so they override any inherited value. Add coverage that runs the control environment construction with the parent OD_BUILD_PROFILE set to knowdesign.
